//: The .next/dev/types entry in `include` is put there by `next dev` itself and
comes back every time the dev server starts, so it is excluded rather than
removed — `exclude` filters `include`, and Next only ever rewrites the latter.
Why: `next dev` and `next build` each generate a routes.d.ts declaring the
same globals (Routes, ParamMap, LayoutProps). With both on the path they
collide, and the dev copy wins — it lists only the routes Turbopack has
compiled so far, often just '/'. That makes `npm run check` fail on the
[locale] layout with a `params: Promise<unknown>` mismatch that does not
exist: the build succeeds while tsc reports errors. The build-generated set
is the complete one and the one `next build` validates against, and nothing
in src/ references these globals, so dropping the dev copy is safe.
